title: Doctoral Education in Chemistry: Faculty perspectives on programmatic elements’ goals and outcomes
content:
Chem. Educ. Res. Pract., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D4RP00308J, Paper
Benedicta Donkor, Melissa A. Collini, Jordan T. Harshman
This qualitative study investigates the goals and outcomes of the individual programmatic elements within US chemistry doctoral programs, based on faculty perspectives. Forty-six faculty participants were interviewed using an interview...
